name: Apollos
bio: Apollos, a Jew from Alexandria, was an eloquent man with a thorough knowledge of the scriptures who came to Ephesus already instructed in the way of the Lord, though he knew only the baptism of John. He began speaking boldly in the synagogue, and when Aquila and Priscilla heard him, they took him in and explained the way of God to him more accurately. He then went on to Achaia, where the brethren wrote ahead to receive him, and he greatly helped the believers there, powerfully confuting the Jews from the scriptures to show that Jesus was the Christ (Acts 18:24-28). His further role in Corinth is told in the chapters ahead.
